decision: Audited the design system and wrote a fix plan. Did not restyle the app.
why: The request was an audit and a sequence of later PRs, and it forbade app refactors in this run.

decision: Counted color decisions instead of assuming raw hex is the cause.
why: Two fixes that both say use tokens would share an untested premise. The count splits role tokens, the approved ramp, and values outside both.
result: 522 role, 5034 ramp or flat, 2999 outside both, in 2549 chrome files

decision: Removed 18 artwork files from the chrome total after the first run.
why: Empty-state illustrations and generated avatar parts held 513 hex codes that are paint, not UI chrome.

decision: Checked family totals against the palette totals.
why: A classifier bug would make the families fail to sum to the bucket.
evidence: default families sum 2252, custom families sum 4248

decision: Compared globals.css with the shadcn zinc template from commit d5920cc.
why: Role tokens can still look generic if their values are the stock kit.
result: light 20 of 25 identical, dark 24 of 24 identical

decision: Did not treat styleguide INT-105 and INT-42 strings as real dark-mode tickets.
why: They are sample tool output in copilot/styleguide/page.tsx, not a theme toggle.
result: no production dark toggle found in src

decision: Rejected StyleX and a three-input generator for the first PRs.
why: Linear's migration was over a thousand PRs after roles already existed. The smallest fix is role values plus a failing count.

decision: Kept accent 262 83% 58% as the default for ds-values.
why: The hue is a brand preference no count can settle. Dark mode should keep that hue instead of the stock gray.
result: operator can name another hue before ds-values

why: The disputed facts are source counts and published docs. A throwaway UI would not change the count.

decision: Skipped issue tracker, docs, chat, observability, errors, and analytics investigators.
why: No MCP in this environment covers those categories. Source control was searched with git log. A why investigator was also spawned for PR history.
evidence: git log on globals.css, tailwind.config.ts, colors.ts, components.json
result: shadcn added in #7316, color tokens documented in #10186

why: The multi-phase plan skill requires a clean check-plan.mjs run.
The classifier is the evidence. A wrong fixture match would poison the totals.
The plan and the count need a reviewable home on dev. Execution of the eight fix PRs waits for an explicit go.

decision: Could not spawn a second-model review of this trail.
why: Claude Opus and Gemini both returned that on-demand usage is required. A same-family review is not a substitute, so none was run.
evidence: Task tool error on claude-opus-5-5-xhigh and gemini-4-argon-medium

decision: Kept role tokens as the feature API after reading the June 2025 ramp rule.
why: PR 10186 said the ramps were the only colors and called HSL legacy. That rule was never linted, PR 9575 had already reverted a one-shot semantic restyle, and sidebar HSL tokens were added after the legacy label was deleted in PR 11763.
evidence: git history on colors.ts, globals.css, ui/button.tsx
result: plan Appendix B and Appendix H name 9575, 10186, and 11763

decision: Named the theme lock in ds-dark-prefix.
why: forcedTheme light in providers.tsx, defaultTheme light in layout.tsx, and darkMode selector .dark-mode are stronger than a missing toggle. dark: and the .dark token block use different selectors.
result: ds-dark-prefix stops only if a user-facing control appears

decision: Left shadcn/no-raw-colors off and kept the audit script as the ratchet.
why: @shadcn/lint 0.1.1 is installed as a dependency and oxlint enables only require-static-classes. no-raw-colors flags palette utilities, which is what the current ramp rule tells people to write.
result: enable no-raw-colors after feature code uses roles

decision: Recorded colors.ts defects in ds-contract without changing hex.
why: red.900 has a trailing space, slate.700 equals slate.800, slate has no 950 so login uses default slate-950, customGray is unused, and the story class bg-light-grey does not match bgLightGrey.
result: ds-contract documents them and does not recolor the app
